item.description:
Experimental build 370.0.12 of Stockbar 3.7.0. Changes since v3.7.0:
- Add an Experimental update channel that follows the experimental branch (#97) - Record milestone 1: every merged change measured against the baseline (#96) - Keep the popover chart's line from doubling back at a gap in time (#95) - Size the in-memory price history arrays to fit (#93) - Read the portfolio chart's history without each snapshot's positions (#92) - Keep the app's log when a benchmark launch fails (#91) - Keep each portfolio snapshot's positions in a sorted array (#90) - Read the stored history at launch away from the main thread (#89) - Record the Rust evaluation and add the script behind its figures (#88) - Read stored portfolio history in batches (#87) - Stop building test-coverage counters into release builds (#85) - Add the benchmark procedure, the baseline and the experimental log (#84)
